scope: Additive Vampstache L1-18 passive heal event and attack-speed audit; retain pinned heal-per-hit data without assuming impact or stacking order.
game_version: Official 2023-12-12 introduction and 2025-02 balance notice; game-file table dated 2026-09-01 and claimed client build 18.600.3 on 2026-09-16; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: Hero Equipment
facts: Vampstache is Common passive Barbarian King Equipment unlocked with Blacksmith level 3. The King heals himself with every attack while it is equipped; replacing Barbarian Puppet with Vampstache removes the Puppet summon ability.
sources.limitations: No per-level heal amount, whether attacks against Walls or immune targets qualify, heal event phase, attack-speed bonus or stacking rule is specified.

sources.title: Hero Equipment Balance Changes!
facts: Supercell announced a Vampstache buff for the February 2025 update.
sources.limitations: The article gives no exact numeric change, attack-speed formula or rollout build.

sources.title: Vampstache: costs, times and levels — Clash of Clans
sources.version: Game-file data dated 2026-09-01, processed 2026-09-03; exact client build unpublished
facts: The TH18 maximum is L18. Per-level DPS bonuses 10-120, ore costs and Blacksmith requirements agree with the pinned payload.
sources.limitations: The page does not publish heal-per-hit or attack-speed values or the heal trigger phase.

sources.title: Vampstache — Clash of Clans Wiki

sources.title: Pinned Vampstache Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: The normalized per-level source_fields preserve healPerHit 60-300, dpsIncrease 10-120 and attackSpeedIncrease +5% to +22%.
sources.limitations: The dated tables verify DPS but not heal-per-hit or attack-speed continuity. The payload does not define attack eligibility, healing phase, cap, rounding or speed-to-cadence conversion.

derivations.result: Keep pinned heal-per-hit, DPS and speed fields data-only
derivations.method: SHA-check the frozen raw per-level stats and cross-check dated DPS tables. No healing event, attack cadence or modifier stacking rule is inferred.

rejected_inferences.rule: Heal on every successful damage impact
rejected_inferences.reason: The official wording says every attack while the raw field says healPerHit; the checked sources do not resolve attack launch versus hit, zero damage or multi-target impacts.

rejected_inferences.rule: Heal when striking Walls or an immune target
rejected_inferences.reason: No checked official source specifies target-category eligibility or whether zero-damage hits trigger healing.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply +5% to +22% attack speed by dividing King's attack interval by 1 plus the percentage
rejected_inferences.reason: The raw field lacks cadence conversion, rounding, stacking and current-build corroboration.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use pinned healPerHit 60-300 as current values
rejected_inferences.reason: The dated 2026 tables omit healing values; the 2025 buff makes historical continuity relevant.

items: attack launch, hit or damage-impact trigger
Wall, immune target, miss and multi-target eligibility
heal before or after target damage, retaliatory damage and death
attack-speed cadence conversion and stacking with Rage Vial or auras
Pet, Phoenix and King defeat interaction
Viewer overlay, snapshot, replay and RL loadout contract

conclusion: Vampstache L1-18 remains partial and catalogue-only. Official sources establish passive healing with every King attack, and dated tables verify its DPS progression, but current healing amount and hit-event ordering are insufficient for a faithful deterministic Core implementation.
